values.name: spectral reflectance reconstruction
values.value: smoothest curve between 0 and 1 with the paint's masstone colour (least hyperbolic tangent slope squared, Newton's method)
values.source: S. A. Burns, Numerical methods for smoothest reflectance reconstruction (2020)

values.name: spectral observer
values.value: CIE 1931 2 degree, multi-lobe Gaussian fit
values.source: Wyman, Sloan and Shirley, Simple analytic approximations to the CIE XYZ colour matching functions (2013)

values.name: spectral illuminant
values.unit: K black body, scaled so a white reflector is sRGB white

values.value: #F7F4EC

values.value: Titanium White #F6F6F2

values.name: colour difference
values.value: CIE76 dE

values.name: match explanation
values.value: pop-up on hover over the match label: meaning of dE, the four bands, this recipe's band highlighted

values.name: method choices
values.value: Mix, Glaze

values.name: method default
values.value: Mix

values.name: glaze paints
values.value: transparent or half-transparent, not white, different from the layer below

values.name: acrylic/oil full glaze: dE from masstone over white ground
values.unit: dE (thinnest film within this, per paint)

values.name: acrylic/oil full glaze: light passed in the most absorbed band
values.unit: T^2 (thinnest film reaching this or the dE rule, per paint)

values.name: lighten checkbox in glaze mode
values.value: Lighten first layer (water or white only in the first layer)

values.name: acrylic/oil first layer
values.value: white ground, or one paint with the white parts tried

values.name: watercolor first layer
values.value: one paint as a wash at the water steps

values.name: glaze words acrylic/oil
values.value: >=0.9 strong, >=0.45 medium, >=0.25 thin, >=0.12 very thin, >=0.06 a veil, else a faint veil

values.name: layer stacking
values.value: R' = R + T^2 Rg / (1 - R Rg) per wavelength band

values.name: glaze search
values.value: exhaustive: first layers x glazes x second glazes, scored dE + 0.8 per paint after the first
